parts.title: Part 1 — Introduction and interview
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask general questions about yourself and a few familiar topics. Answer naturally and try to extend each answer with a reason or example. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: Let's talk about food. Do you like cooking?
What kind of food do you enjoy eating most?
Now let's talk about the environment. Do you think environmental problems are serious in your country?
What do you do personally to protect the environment?
Are people in your country becoming more aware of environmental issues?
Let's move on to school subjects. Did you enjoy studying science at school?
What was your favourite subject when you were young?
Do you think schools should teach more about environmental issues?

parts.title: Part 2 — Individual long turn
parts.instructions: You will be given a topic card. You have one minute to prepare and may make notes. Then speak for one to two minutes. Try to keep talking until the examiner stops you.
parts.cue_card_topic: Describe an environmental problem that affects your country.
cue_card_bullets: and explain what can be done to solve it

questions.question: Do you think this problem will get better or worse in the future?

parts.title: Part 3 — Two-way discussion
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask further questions connected to the Part 2 topic. These are more abstract and require you to explain, compare, and speculate. Try to give extended, well-reasoned answers. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: What are the main environmental problems facing the world today?
Who do you think should be responsible for protecting the environment — individuals or governments?
Some people say individual actions make little difference without government policy. Do you agree?
Do you think education can help solve environmental problems?
How might people's attitudes towards the environment change in the next twenty years?
Should countries be punished for failing to meet environmental targets? Why or why not?
